decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and with a very close fit to the firm's integrated airport-operations portfolio, this product likely performs at least near aspiration and is worth retaining as the firm scales software and service integration.

Its monitoring function supports the firm's data-driven lifecycle-service strategy and installed-base complementarities, so management would usually keep it unless newer evidence shows a clear shortfall versus expectations.

Because safety-critical offerings are central to the firm's value proposition and this service remained after the 2024 portfolio pruning, management would likely continue it while exploiting learning and customer relationships.
